import django, os
os.environ[''DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE'']=''ardt_fms.settings''
django.setup\(\)
from apps.erp_automation.models import WorkflowStep, Locator, Workflow

wf = Workflow.objects.get\(pk=79\)
loc = Locator.objects.get\(name=''d365_ok_button_attribute''\)

# Add step between 36 and 37 — click OK on attributes dialog \(continue_on_error for accounts without it\)
step = WorkflowStep.objects.create\(
    workflow=wf,
    order=36.5,  # Will sort between 36 and 37 — let me use a proper int
    name=''Click OK \(Attributes Dialog\)'',
    action_type=''click'',
    locator=loc,
    wait_after=2000,
    continue_on_error=True,
    interaction_mode=''dialog_button'',
\)
print\(f''Created step pk={step.pk}, order={step.order}''\)

# Now renumber: need to shift this to a clean number. Let me set order to 36 \(between 36 and 37 won''t work with int\)
# Actually WorkflowStep.order is IntegerField. Let me renumber steps 37+ to make room.
# First, shift all steps >= 37 up by 1
steps_to_shift = WorkflowStep.objects.filter\(workflow=wf, order__gte=37\).exclude\(pk=step.pk\).order_by\(''-order''\)
for s in steps_to_shift:
    s.order = s.order + 1
    s.save\(update_fields=[''order'']\)
    print\(f''  Shifted step ""{s.name}"" to order {s.order}''\)

# Now set new step to order 37
step.order = 37
step.save\(update_fields=[''order'']\)
print\(f''Set new step order to 37''\)

# Verify
print\(\)
print\(''Updated WF-2 steps:''\)
for s in WorkflowStep.objects.filter\(workflow=wf\).order_by\(''order''\):
    loc_name = s.locator.name if s.locator else ''None''
    coe = '' [continue_on_error]'' if s.continue_on_error else ''''
    print\(f''  {s.order}: ""{s.name}"" \({s.action_type}\) locator={loc_name}{coe}''\)
")
